name: tiraze
description: Tiraze / تيراز — custom Egypt-first silk rug commerce (Astro + Cloudflare Workers + D1). The legacy static preview remains at the repository root.

scripts.typecheck: node apps/web/scripts/sync-assets.mjs && pnpm -r --parallel run typecheck && tsc -p tools/tsconfig.json
scripts.db:migrate:local: pnpm --filter @tiraze/web exec wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --local
scripts.db:seed:fixtures:local: pnpm --filter @tiraze/web exec wrangler d1 execute DB --local --file ../../packages/db/fixtures/test-fixtures.sql
